scope: Fresh source-cued Chapter 2 story and context replacements

shots.prompt: A child-friendly 3D animated film from a quiet beach at sea level. One small wooden sailing ship travels steadily away from the camera across a calm blue ocean. Over five continuous seconds, the lower hull sinks from view behind the distant natural sea horizon while the upper mast remains visible for longer. Gentle daylight and a steady camera keep the simple ship-and-water action easy for a student to understand.

shots.narration_cue: you continue moving forward when you stop a bike suddenly
shots.prompt: A safe child-friendly 3D animated film in a bright green park. A ten-year-old child wearing a bicycle helmet pedals slowly, then smoothly brakes to a stop. The child's upper body naturally leans forward for a moment before settling upright, illustrating continued forward motion. The bicycle stays in frame and the rider remains balanced. One continuous five-second camera view with clear readable action and warm family-animation lighting.

shots.narration_cue: Spring – Occurs between winter and summer
shots.prompt: A polished child-friendly 3D animated park in spring. New green leaves unfold on a single tree, small flowers open among fresh grass, and gentle sunshine warms the scene. The same park remains in view through one continuous five-second shot, with a smooth restrained camera glide and natural spring movement. Soft blue sky, clear cheerful composition, and no people or objects unrelated to the season.
